error.title: Something went wrong
error.offlineBody: Check that the AnnaSaathi server is running and your phone is on the same Wi-Fi. Your changes are kept.
home.shopHeadline: Let's shop only for what your family needs.
home.haveLine: {n} items are already at home — no need to buy them again. Next shop: {day}.
home.noDish: Add groceries to get cooking suggestions.
home.atRisk: About {amount} of food may spoil before it's eaten at your usual pace. Cooking the suggestions above helps.
home.noRisk: At your usual pace, everything at home should be eaten in time.
shop.title: Shopping list
shop.subtitle: For {day} · {n} to buy · about {amount}
shop.savedBanner: Buying these amounts instead of your usual ones avoids about {amount} ({kg} kg) of food going to waste.
shop.emptyBody: Your kitchen has enough until the next shop. Scan a bill after shopping to keep this list right.
shop.rule: How quantities are worked out: what your family uses each day × the shorter of how long it keeps and the days until your next shop, minus what's still fresh at home, rounded to a pack size.
shop.startHint: Plans the list for today and lets you tick items off
shop.finishBody: What you ticked off is already in My Kitchen. Anything you didn't buy will be planned again for your next shop.
shop.finished: Shopping done. My Kitchen is up to date.
shop.atHomeNeed: Still fresh at home {home} · Needed till next shop {need}
shop.topup: Top up {qty} on {day} instead of buying it all now — it won't keep that long.
kitchen.title: My Kitchen
kitchen.subtitle: {n} items at home
kitchen.weather: {temp}°C {city} · shelf life adjusted for the weather ({source})
kitchen.addBody: How much did you get? It goes into My Kitchen as bought today.
kitchen.emptyBody: Scan your next grocery bill and everything appears here with how long it keeps.
kitchen.checkBody: Tap still have, finished or thrown. That's all the logging.
kitchen.disclaimer: Freshness is an estimate, not a guarantee of safety. Printed dates come first. Always check look and smell — when in doubt, throw it out.
item.gone: This item is no longer in My Kitchen
item.fromPrinted: From the date printed on the pack
item.spoiledAdvice: This is past its usual freshness window. Look and smell before using it — when in doubt, throw it out.
item.printedHelp: Enter the use-by or best-before date printed on the pack. It replaces our estimate.
item.boughtHelp: When was this bought? Freshness is counted from this day.
item.removeBody: Use this if it was added by mistake. If it was eaten or thrown away, the weekly check is better — it helps plan the right amounts.
cook.title: Cook today
cook.subtitle: Dishes that use what needs to go first
cook.methodNote: Amounts are planned for your family (eats like {n} adults). Oil, salt and spices for tempering aren't counted.
cook.sheetBody: These amounts are estimated for your family. Change anything that's different and we'll take it out of My Kitchen.
cook.notAtHome: Not at home, so nothing to take out: {list}
cook.emptyBody: Scan a grocery bill and we'll suggest dishes that use what spoils first.
cooked.none: No cooked food logged right now.
cooked.emptyBody: When you mark a dish as cooked, it shows here with a finish-by time.
cooked.moved: Finish-by time updated for the fridge
cooked.thrownNote: Noted. Smaller batches next time can help.
cooked.safety: Finish-by times use the stricter of home habit and USDA/FSSAI guidance. Appearance and smell are not proof that cooked food is safe.
impact.title: Impact
impact.subtitle: What following the advice could change
impact.simulatedNote: Simulated, not measured: {n} synthetic households over {days} days (fixed seed {seed}). Real households will vary.
impact.simulatedShort: These are simulated estimates, not measured results.
impact.followingHelp: {n}% of the time. The rest of the time they buy and cook as usual.
impact.wasteLabel: Food wasted per household per month
impact.runOutLabel: Times an item ran out / month
impact.how1: {n} synthetic Indian households (average {p} people) are simulated day by day for {days} days, shopping every week.
impact.how2: Both arms see exactly the same families and appetites, so the difference comes only from how they buy and cook.
impact.how3: Raw simulated waste ({raw} kg per person a year) is scaled by one factor so the usual-habits baseline matches UNEP's {target} kg for India. Both arms use the same factor, so the % cut is unchanged.
impact.how4: Run the same simulation again and you get the same numbers.
impact.yoursBody: From the items you marked as thrown in weekly checks. This is what was recorded, not a simulation.
impact.yoursNone: Nothing marked as thrown yet. When you do a weekly check, what you record shows here, separate from the simulation.
scan.title: Add a bill
scan.subtitle: A week's groceries in under 30 seconds
scan.takePhoto: Take a photo of the bill
scan.liveOff: Photo reading isn't set up on this server
scan.privacyLive: Your photo is sent to your AnnaSaathi server, which asks Claude (Anthropic) to read the items. The photo isn't saved. Cover any phone numbers or names if you prefer.
scan.privacyOff: Without it, a photo can't be read and you'll see the sample bill instead, clearly marked. Pasting order text works without it.
scan.sampleBody: Try a prepared sample: Shree Ganesh Kirana, 18 items.
scan.cameraDenied: Camera access is off. You can choose a photo from your gallery instead.
scan.frameTip: Fit the whole bill inside the frame
scan.lightTip: Lay it flat in good light and avoid shadows
scan.previewHint: Every line and price should be readable. Blurry or cut-off lines may be read wrongly.
scan.readingBody: Finding items, quantities and prices… this usually takes a few seconds.
scan.pasteBody: Copy the item list from a delivery app or a printed bill and paste it here.
scan.reviewBody: Tap any line to fix it. Lines we're unsure about are highlighted.
scan.doneBody: Your shopping list and cooking suggestions are updated.
scan.draftTitle: You have an unsaved bill from {shop}
review.sampleBody: This is a prepared bill for trying the app, not your photo.
review.alreadyImported: This bill was already added on {date}. Adding it again replaces it — nothing is counted twice.
review.editHint: Opens the line to fix it
review.checkHint: Highlighted lines will be added as shown unless you fix them.
review.keptDraft: Your edits are kept — try again.
review.dupBody: Adding it again would count these groceries twice.
review.dupKeep: It's the same bill — don't add
review.dupAdd: It's a new bill — add it
review.unknownHint: Not a grocery we track? Leave it out.
voice.title: Say what you bought
voice.subtitle: In English, हिंदी or मराठी
voice.howTo: Tap the microphone on your keyboard and speak, or type. For example: “आज अर्धा किलो टोमॅटो घेतले”.
voice.placeholder: e.g. 2 kilo kanda, ek litre doodh
voice.nothing: We couldn't find any groceries in that. Try naming the item and amount.
check.title: Weekly check
check.noGuilt: No judgement — this only helps us suggest the right amounts next time.
check.doneBody: Your family's amounts are updated for the next shopping list.
check.emptyBody: Fresh items from your bills show up here once a week.
alerts.title: Needs attention
alerts.subtitle: Only what matters today
alerts.emptyBody: Nothing needs your attention right now.
family.title: Family
family.name: Family name
family.saved: Saved. Your list and suggestions are updated.
family.noMedical: Preferences are only used to plan food. AnnaSaathi doesn't give medical or calorie advice.
profile.name: Name
profile.needsHint: Only what your family wants planned in.
profile.intervalHint: How often you do the main shop
profile.fridgeHint: Without one, fresh food is planned for the counter
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageNote: Item names and the main screens change language. Some detailed explanations are in English for now.
settings.serverHint: Leave empty to use the computer running the app.
settings.demoBody: Set up your own family, or bring back the Patil demo family as it was before this week's shop.
settings.resetBody: This replaces the current family, kitchen and history with the Patil demo family.
picker.search: Search in English, हिंदी or मराठी
welcome.tagline: Buy right. Cook first. Waste less.
welcome.p1: Know exactly how much to buy, right at the shop
welcome.p2: See what's at home and what to use first
welcome.p3: Get dishes that use up food before it spoils
welcome.setupNote: No account or phone number needed.
welcome.noServerBody: Start the server on your computer, keep your phone on the same Wi-Fi, or enter the server address.
onb.s1Body: Just a family name to get started. Shelf life uses the weather in Pune for now.
onb.s2Body: Tap to add each person. Age sets the portion size; you can rename anyone.
onb.s3Body: Sensible defaults are already chosen. Change only what's different for you.
onb.freshHint: Recommended. Then scan your last bill.
